checks.setup: Front oblique and side sheets inspected; complete body and apparatus visible.
checks.hands: Arms relaxed beside chair; torso upright.
checks.feet: Both feet remain flat and fixed while both knees open symmetrically against band.
checks.movement: Sit upright on stool, band above knees, feet flat. Open both knees against band without moving pelvis, then return slowly. 3.5 seconds open, 1 second pause, 3.5 seconds close.

limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Sampled garment-seat clearance is 0.015 to 0.1 model units; full mesh collision is not certified.
